team_members.name: Youssef Josephson, D.O.
team_members.bio: Known to patients as Dr. Joe. Board-certified in Pain Medicine and Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, he treats chronic and acute pain including back pain, neck pain, joint pain, nerve pain, arthritis, fibromyalgia, CRPS, and post-surgical pain.

team_members.name: Teresa Clark, MSN, CRNP
team_members.bio: Teresa works with patients between procedures on medication management, follow-up, and the day-to-day work of keeping a pain plan on track.

team_members.name: Thomas Haley, D.O.
team_members.bio: Dr. Haley sees patients across the full range of chronic pain conditions treated at the practice.

why_choose_us.title: Same-day appointments available
why_choose_us.description: Most people wait months to get in front of a pain specialist. We accept same-day appointments and we are actively taking new patients — call (570) 232-3920 and ask.

why_choose_us.title: A board-certified pain physician
why_choose_us.description: Dr. Youssef Josephson, D.O. is board-certified in Pain Medicine and Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation. You are seeing a specialist, not a general practice that also treats pain.

why_choose_us.title: Procedures, not just prescriptions
why_choose_us.description: Spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency ablation, epidural and facet injections, nerve blocks, Vertiflex, Intracept, MILD, prolotherapy — roughly forty interventional options, so the plan fits the diagnosis.

why_choose_us.title: You will be listened to
why_choose_us.description: Every visit starts by finding the actual source of your pain. Patients arrive here after being dismissed elsewhere; that is not how a first appointment goes at this practice.

services_section.subtitle: Back, neck, joint, and nerve pain — plus the complex conditions other practices send here. Serving Wilkes-Barre and the Wyoming Valley.
